(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((clean-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                                        (let ((v (at g r 0)))
                                          (and
                                            (!= v 0)
                                            (all? (lambda (kc) (= (at g r kc) v))
                                                  (range 1 w)))))
                                      (range 0 h)))
                  (clean (and (> (length clean-rows) 0) (at g (first clean-rows) 0))))
             (if clean
                 (list (list clean))
                 (let* ((dirty-row (find-first (lambda (r)
                                                 (let ((v (at g r 0)))
                                                   (and
                                                     (!= v 0)
                                                     (> (for/sum ((kc (range 0 w)))
                                                          (if (= (at g r kc) v) 1 0))
                                                        (- w 2)))))
                                               (range 0 h)))
                        (dr dirty-row)
                        (major (at g dr 0))
                        (anom (find-first (lambda (v) (!= v major))
                                          (map (lambda (kc) (at g dr kc)) (range 0 w)))))
                   (list (list anom))))))))

(rule!
 (lambda (g)
   (let* ([height (rows g)]
          [width (cols g)]
          [colors (sort (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c 0)))
                                (remove-duplicates (apply append g))) <)]
          [cells (lambda (color)
                   (for*/list ([r (range 0 height)] [c (range 0 width)]
                               #:when (= (at g r c) color))
                     (list r c)))]
          [horizontal? (lambda (color)
                         (let* ([positions (cells color)]
                                [rs (map first positions)]
                                [cs (map second positions)])
                           (> (- (apply max cs) (apply min cs))
                              (- (apply max rs) (apply min rs)))))]
          [hs (filter horizontal? colors)]
          [vs (filter (lambda (color) (not (horizontal? color))) colors)]
          [covered-colors
           (remove-duplicates
            (for*/list ([h hs] [v vs]
                        [r (remove-duplicates (map first (cells h)))]
                        [c (remove-duplicates (map second (cells v)))])
              (at g r c)))]
          [bottom (filter (lambda (color) (not (member color covered-colors))) colors)])
     (if (= (length bottom) 1)
         (list (list (first bottom)))
         (error 'back-layer "expected one band below every crossing")))))
